snippet.title: Salt and Spice - Exploration, Trade and Contracts
snippet.description:
Salt and Spice is a historical maritime trade strategy game set in the 16th-century Indian Ocean.

Explore bustling ports, accept merchant contracts, establish profitable trade routes, and build your trading empire across East Africa, Arabia, Persia, and India.
